metadata.description: Apogee — personal fork of the Claude Code Development Kit (CCDK). `apogee`: the workflow machinery (durable docs context, br issue memory, git-flow conventions, two safety hooks, the prime/plan/run-plan/merge/release entry points, the docs/apogee doc loop). `apogee-media`: the image skills (generation via agy/Gemini, precise edits, background removal), enabled separately.

plugins.name: apogee
plugins.description: Claude Code workflow machinery: lifecycle hooks (secret scan + the production-branch wall, plus context injectors), workflow skills (update-docs, review-work, second-opinion, public-docs, readme, symfony, ai-clean-room, br, git-commit, git-flow), and the init/prime/plan-feature/release/merge/run-plan entry-point skills. Install once, enable per project.

plugins.name: apogee-media
plugins.description: Image skills that travel with Apogee but are not part of the work loop: image-gen (character art and variations via agy/Gemini), image-edit (crop, resize, mirror, trim), bg-remove (rembg). Enable only in projects that produce visual assets.
